title: Add Omega benchmark target
summary: 建立 frontend-neutral 的 Omega benchmark target，统一收集 response、tool trace 和 delivery summary。
requirement: Add a benchmark target adapter that can execute Omega through a frontend-neutral runtime boundary and normalize response, tool, and delivery evidence for scoring.
acceptance: benchmark target can execute a single case against Omega
response and tool trace are normalized into one case result shape
delivery summary is attached when available
target boundary does not depend on omega-tui
